queries.name: fact_totals
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_facts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN explicit=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS explicit_facts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN explicit=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS inferred_facts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN explicit IN (0,1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),0) AS invalid_explicit_flags, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),0) AS nondefault_graph_facts FROM facts

queries.name: predicate_groups
queries.sql: WITH grouped AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT explicit,p,COUNT(*) AS facts FROM facts GROUP BY explicit,p) SELECT grouped.explicit,grouped.p,grouped.facts,terms.n AS predicate_n,terms.kind AS predicate_kind FROM grouped LEFT JOIN terms ON terms.id=grouped.p ORDER BY grouped.explicit,terms.n,grouped.p
